question:

solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. pull strings.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The idiom "Pull strings" means use influence to get things done.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. pull strings.

• Option 1: taste of your own medicine (जैसी करनी वैसी भरनी): This idiom means get same bad treatment, which does not fit the context of the given sentence.
